summary: Nothing structured confirmed: the operator's pages state no rate, site count or hookups, and stored hookups (water, sewer) and 41 sites rest on the old note. Note cleaned of those facts. Waterfront lead below.
flags: PRIVATE GATE FACTS: no posted rate anywhere on the operator's site (home, Campground/Cabins, Policies) and no booking engine; RV Life $$ is the only price indicator. Good Sam: 'Birch Point Lodge Campground & Cottage Resort', not a GS Park, gs false, military false. Gateway not run, as there's no rate to test. Presence: own site, phone. Google 'Birch Point Lodge Campgrounds' 4.3 on 192 reviews, open. RV Life 4.0. The Google reviews I read speak of cabins, boats and the restaurant, one saying 'The resort operates year round'; none described an RV site. One calls the restaurant service 'by far probably the worse I have ever experienced'.
PHONE: entry has an empty phone. Operator and Google give 207-463-2515. apply.py doesn't write phone.

UNSUPPORTED: hookups water/sewer and sites 41 have only the old note behind them; operator says just 'pitching a tent or parking their RV'. I left them as stored rather than clearing them, because I have no contrary statement. Say if derived-from-note with no operator support should be nulled here.
SEASONAL: operator mentions no seasonal sites and gives no share. Imagery shows a few RVs parked in the N and E parts of the grounds; can't call their tenure from overhead.

WATERFRONT lead, low confidence, no change: stored 'not waterfront'. Operator says 'stunning lake views' for Campground Spaces and 'by the shore', which is marketing and a contrary claim that triggers a look. Imagery: the shoreline in frame is taken by the red-roofed cottages and lodge; the open field and RV spots sit behind them, some 100-250 m back. Nothing places an RV site on or in sight of the water, so it stays down. A site map would settle it; the operator posts none.
PIN fine: stored point sits on the entry road just N of the lodge lot, within ~250 m of the visible grounds; Good Sam's point is ~200 m N.
UNREAD: rates, season for campsites (operator names summer and winter activity, no campground dates).
